newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moran-1X well in PNG flows 2,273 bpd oil, gas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moran-1X well in PNG flows 2,273 bpd oil, gas.

text.p: The Moran-1X Side Track-4 well in Papua New Guinea (PNG) flowed 2,273 barrels per day (bpd) of 45.1 degree API oil accompanied by gas in a drill stem test of the Digimu Sandstone, Oil Search Ltd said on Wednesday.
The initial DST rate was constrained to less than 2,500 bpd to optimise the pressure information derived from the test, Oil Search said.
The forward plan is to conduct a deliverability DST over the Digimu Sandstone by increasing the choke size followed by a DST over the Toro C Sandstone, Oil Search said.

Moran-lX S/T 4 is located in PDL-2 in the central Papuan Highlands and is being drilled to appraise the structural confirmation of the Moran Anticline and to further delineate the extent of the oil column identified by Moran 1X, and Side Tracks 1, 2 and 3, it said.
The well is located 11 km from the Agogo processing facilities which forms the northern extension of the Kutubu Development.

The PDL-2 licence holders participating in the well are: Oil Search 7.763 percent, Chevron Corp (operator) and The British Petroleum Co Plc 19.375 percent each, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd 9.688 percent, Mobil Corp unit Ampolex Ltd 16.455 percent, Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd affiliate Japan Papua New Guinea Petroleum Co Ltd (JPP) 4.844 percent, Orogen Minerals (Ltd 15.750 percent and Petroleum Resources Kutubu Pty Ltd 6.750 percent.
